name: caj2pdf-rust
description: Streaming CAJ, KDH, and PDF to PDF conversion for browsers and Node.js through WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --locked --release --all-features -p caj2pdf-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.prepack: node -e "if (require('node:fs').readFileSync('caj2pdf_wasm.wasm').readUInt32BE(0) !== 0x0061736d) throw new Error('caj2pdf_wasm.wasm is not a WebAssembly module')"
